name: Kodak Professional Ektachrome E100
source: Kodak Alaris, KODAK PROFESSIONAL EKTACHROME Film E100, publication E-4000 (2018-08), pages 3-4

notes.characteristic: Daylight exposure 1/100 s, process E-6, Status A densitometry.
notes.sensitivity: Effective exposure 1/10 s, E-6, E.N.D. density 1.0, sensitivity = 1/exposure (erg/cm2).
notes.dye_density: Dyes normalized to form a visual neutral density of 1.0 for a viewing illuminant of 5000 K, process E-6.

grain.note: Diffuse rms granularity, read at gross diffuse visual density 1.0, 48 µm aperture (no magnification stated).
